messages:
zoe-finance: Acquirer just submitted a CHARGEBACK for acct_3077. Cardholder disputes a $95 "partner commission" line on their invoice. Payouts on hold. Need evidence packet + recommendation.

ben-payments: Can you paste tx ids/timeframe? I'll grab auth chain + descriptor mapping.

zoe-finance: TX-3077-INV ($1,200) and TX-3077-FEE ($95). Posted 2026-04-10 10:15 UTC. Billing contact billing@orbit.tools.

chargeback-bot: AUTOMATED: fraud_score=0.20, descriptor_mismatch=TRUE, partner_id=routeplus-21, recommend=REVIEW + SEND_ITEMIZED_INVOICE.

rita-cs: Customer says they never agreed to any partner fee and opened a dispute. They want immediate refund of $95 and escalated to their account manager.

ops-bot: Note: billing feature PARTNER-PASSTHROUGH rolled to 10% of accounts on 2026-03-28; acct_3077 was in cohort. Email notification sent to ops@orbit.tools on 2026-03-29.

ben-payments: Quick artifacts I'll attach: masked_pan **** **** **** 1212, TX-3077-INV $1200, TX-3077-FEE $95, descriptor_lines map. Uploading bundle to S3 now (restricted).

sam-legal: Before we send to issuer: redact PAN, include itemized invoice showing fee line, copy of cohort notification email, reseller agreement excerpt with fee terms (redacted), and timeline of when the feature was enabled. Do not include CVV.

zoe-finance: Recommendation: 1) Submit redacted evidence to issuer to contest. 2) Offer $50 goodwill credit only if customer provides written pause of dispute. 3) Temporarily hold further payouts to partner routeplus-21 pending review. Approve?

sam-legal: Approve evidence submit. Approve goodwill credit only if CS gets written pause. Approve holding new payouts to partner pending contract review.

rita-cs: I'll escalate to account manager and request written confirmation to pause the dispute in exchange for the $50 credit. Customer is asking to speak to a manager now.

ben-payments: Submitting representment with redacted bundle now; will post acquirer confirmation id when done.

chargeback-bot: Case logged CB-2026-3077.

zoe-finance: Thanks team. Keep updates here and tag me on any bank replies or customer notes.
